security_sql_injection.detail: src/definition/snapshot.zig reviewed in full. All SQL queries in SnapshotStore.create and SnapshotStore.getByInstanceId use parameterised $N placeholders via pg.zig — no string interpolation of user data. UUID values are serialised to hex by uuidToHex() and bound as $1/$2 parameters. No OWASP A03 (SQL Injection) risk found.
